scheme_name: Scheme for Relief and Rehabilitation of Women Acid Victims
other_conditions: Applicant must be a girl/woman who is a victim of an acid attack
The acid attack must have occurred on or after 02.05.2011
The acid attack must have taken place within Haryana
Applicant must be a resident of Haryana
Applicant should not have been fully cured or completed all medical procedures, i.e., ongoing treatment is required
benefits_summary: Provides a total ad‑hoc relief of ₹1,00,000 (₹25,000 immediately and ₹75,000 within 15 days) and 100% free medical treatment including medicines, food, bedding and necessary surgeries.
